about: A JavaScript library that knows the public holidays of countries around the world.

prs.title: Korean New Year holiday starts on the right day
prs.broken: The three-day Seollal holiday in South Korea started one day late every year, so the day before the lunar new year counted as a work day.
prs.changed: The holiday now starts the day before the lunar new year, matching the official Korean calendar for 2020 to 2030.
prs.matters: Calendars and scheduling apps using this library now show the real days off in South Korea.
